scope: Static decompilation, disassembly, file facts and offline string-vault decoding; sample code was not executed.
behavior: Main.initialize(String) immediately POSTs the first-stage account context to /api/receive/sess, then collects local credentials and uploads JSON to /api/receive/DTA. Individual collected files are uploaded as multipart bodies to /api/receive/file; execution logs use /api/receive/logs.
The same Ethereum contract and selector used by the first stage resolve the server hostname. An OkHttp DNS implementation resolves target hosts through Cloudflare/Google DNS-over-HTTPS.

DiscordHandler scans desktop-client and browser LevelDB data for plaintext and encrypted tokens, recovers the Local State master key with DPAPI/AES-GCM, and validates candidate tokens with the Discord users/@me API.
PasswordHandler, CookieHandler and AutofillHandler copy Chromium SQLite stores, query login/cookie/autofill records and decrypt protected values. BrowserHelper reads os_crypt/app_bound_encrypted_key.

DllInjectionHelper launches a browser suspended, uses remote allocation/write/thread APIs, maps a generated x64 PE/COM decryption payload into it, and receives recovered keys through a named pipe. ABEPayloadReal constructs that image, including IElevator calls.
FirefoxHandler copies profile material and uses NSS_Init and PK11SDR_Decrypt to recover saved credentials; it also reads cookies.sqlite.
FileHandler collects Minecraft launcher accounts (including Modrinth and Feather recovery), desktop/browser wallet material, Roblox cookies and Steam cached tokens.
WHandler fetches replacements for Exodus resources/app.asar and Discord desktop-core index.js; it kills Exodus before replacing its application archive.

PythonInstaller downloads the official Windows embedded Python runtime, fetches /api/static/python, and executes returned source by writing it to the stdin of python -c import sys;exec(sys.stdin.read()).

A separate StagingHelper contains a JAR launcher with --add-to-registry; it is not called from the inspected Main path. CryptoHelper includes an embedded RSA private signing key and an rsaSign helper; no call to that helper was found in the inspected application sources.

donkers/rt/Dec decrypts a 24-bit-length-indexed resource table with an LCG64 keystream. Guard checks resource SHA-256 hashes and corrupts the custom VM key when integrity fails. Dummy classes and a custom reflective VM complicate decompilation.
limitations: No follow-on Python, Discord JavaScript, Exodus ASAR or separate JAR payload was fetched.

JADX reported 23 errors across the full fat JAR; no Method not decompiled/JADX ERROR markers were found in the application classes. Native injection was corroborated with compiled method references and bytecode.
Network downloads prove availability at collection time; they do not demonstrate runtime credential theft on an infected host.

notes: API references placed by their supported operations; metadata descriptors do not claim imports.
ABI obfuscation and collector string concealment no longer assert unsupported C2 or interpreter-stdin handoffs.
Browser-store extraction is a separately required role; generic secret APIs without it do not satisfy the browser collector.
